history.summary: A compact 1,281 sqft 4BR in a D05 leasehold completed 2018, asking $1,639 psf vs a $1,554 project median. Decent $2.1M quantum within the liquid band, but weak 2.2%/yr appreciation and no listed MRT proximity hold it back.
history.rating_rationale: $2.1M sits in the deeper buyer band and the 1,281 sqft 4BR is efficiently sized (not oversized), supporting a slightly broader exit pool than most 4BRs. However the URA series, while a usable 53 txns, shows only 2.2%/yr — below the RCR/OCR baseline — and the listing is ~5% above the project median PSF. No strong MRT adjacency listed. D05 (West Coast/Clementi) benefits from One-North/Pasir Panjang but this specific pocket is car-dependent.
red_flags: Weak 2.2%/yr resale CAGR, below regional baseline
